_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG157 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.plan_basis: cgpg_split_proposals.json PG157 (consistency review: ok). Credited works tlg3168.006/007 (Preger apparatus) have no Migne text and get no range. The Hagia Sophia section (314-324) stays inside the Patria (tlg3168.005) and is not double-served as tlg3120.002
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG157.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG157.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG157.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.

works.evidence: Locus 382 carries the heading 'Ἀριθμοὶ ἐτῶν...' and the exact incipit of Ducas 1.1 ('Ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ τοῦ πρώτου ἀνθρώπου ἕως Νῶε... γενεαὶ δέκα γεγόνασι'); continuous into the emperor list (385-387), the Ottoman emirates and Hellespont crossing (387-389), Kosovo/Murad's assassination (390), Bayezid (391), the Kantakouzenos narrative (393-395); ends at 590 mid-sentence in the 1462 siege of Mytilene ('Ὁρῶντες οὖν οἱ ἐντὸς...'), matching the famous abrupt break-off of Ducas ch. 45. Served 68858 words vs TLG 70405 (98%).
